text: Provides suite functions preprocessing quality assurance syndromic surveillance data obtained National Syndromic Surveillance Program (NSSP) Electronic Surveillance System Early Notification Community-based Epidemics (ESSENCE) API. Functions address common data quality challenges including visit-level deduplication mechanism classification, care setting filtering facility type correction, emergency department inpatient encounter linkage accurate burden estimation, geographic attribution --state non-residential visits.
